pocket_depth / 2\n\n            hole = cylinder(r=pocket_r, h=pocket_depth)\n            hole = hole.translate(x, y, z)\n            base = base - hole\n\n    # Chamfer edges at top\n    for edge in base.edges().filter(lambda e: e.is_top()):\n        base = base.chamfer(chamfer, edge)\n\n    return base\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":1,"oldLines":6,"newStart":1,"newLines":5,"lines":[" from parts import *"," ","-@part"," def bit_block(shank_diameter: float = 6.0, columns: int = 5) -> Part:","     \"\"\"Bench block to hold driver bits upright."," "]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false}}

pocket_depth / 2\n\n            hole = Cylinder(radius=pocket_r, height=pocket_depth)\n            hole = hole.translate(Vector(x, y, z))\n            base = base - hole\n\n    # Chamfer top edges: pocket mouths and outer perimeter (0.8 x 45 degree)\n    top_edges = []\n    for edge in base.edges():\n        # Get edge center point\n        try:\n            center = edge.center()\n            # Check if edge is near the top surface\n            if hasattr(center, '__getitem__'):\n                z = center[2]\n            elif hasattr(center, 'Z'):\n                z = center.Z\n            else:\n                # Try getting attributes\n                z = getattr(center, 'z', None)\n                if z is None:\n                    continue\n\n            if abs(z - block_h) < 0.5:\n                top_edges.append(edge)\n        except:\n            pass\n\n    if top_edges:\n        base = polish(base, top_edges, 0.8)\n\n    return base\n","numLines":65,"startLine":1,"totalLines":65}}}
